rules.rule: src/routeTree.gen.ts is generated by `bun run generate-routes`. Flag any manual edit to this file — the correct fix is to change the route files under src/routes/ and regenerate.
This is a public marketing site with no auth or customer data. Flag any hardcoded API key, product credential, or server-side call using a real secret.
A new page/route or new content section should be reflected in scripts/generate-sitemap.ts and scripts/generate-llms.ts, or explain why it's intentionally excluded (e.g. a legal/utility page).
